items.title: How many users a bug reaches at each canary percentage
items.description: This simplified model shows the blast radius of a bug at each canary percentage, assuming the bug affects every user routed to the new version. L3 uses hashing and gets approximate counts; this version uses a direct percentage so you can focus on the exposure idea.
items.compute: const usersAffected = Math.round(params.totalUsers * (params.canaryPercent / 100)); return { usersAffected, usersProtected: params.totalUsers - usersAffected };

outputs.label: Users still protected from the bug
